description: Add the offline-synthable MahaloBuilderStack (arm64 AL2023 EC2 builder) and wire it into the CDK app, fix the stale template-count docstring, and add per-stack assertion tests. Grounded in task7b-design.md Â§A/Â§E/Â§F and the gitea_stack.py offline-safe VPC/EC2 pattern. This is the foundation the deploy script and runbook (FEAT-002/003) reference; it must land first and keep the offline, Docker-free synth gate green.
steps: CREATE infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/builder_stack.py defining MahaloBuilderStack(Stack). Mirror gitea_stack.py's offline-safe pattern: add an `availability_zones` @property returning [f'{self.region}a']; create ec2.Vpc(self,'BuilderVpc', max_azs=1, nat_gateways=0, subnet_configuration=[one PUBLIC subnet]) (CREATED, not from_lookup); a security group ec2.SecurityGroup(allow_all_outbound=True) with ZERO ingress rules (do NOT call add_ingress_rule at all).

In builder_stack.py add CfnParameters BuilderInstanceType (default 't4g.large') and BuilderVolumeSizeGiB (default 40). Create iam.Role(assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal('ec2.amazonaws.com'), managed_policies=[AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore, AdministratorAccess]) with a comment stating the AdministratorAccess breadth is deliberately lifetime-scoped to a transient single-owner-demo builder (design Â§A.4).

In builder_stack.py build the UserData per design Â§A.5: ec2.UserData.for_linux() running as root with `set -uxo pipefail` (NOT -e at top; each critical step guarded). Commands: dnf install -y docker && systemctl enable --now docker; guarded `usermod -aG docker ssm-user 2>/dev/null || true`; dnf install -y git; Node 24 install (NodeSource/nvm path for AL2023 arm64 â€” confirm on host); Python 3.13 tolerant install `dnf install -y python3.13 python3.13-pip || dnf install -y python3.13 || true`; ensure AWS CLI v2 present; `npm install -g aws-cdk@2.x.y` pinned to a version matching aws-cdk-lib>=2.251,<3 (NOT floating aws-cdk@2); initial guarded clone `git clone "$REPO_URL" /home/ssm-user/mahalo-agentcore 2>/dev/null || true` with REPO_URL=https://github.com/tjblavakumar/mahalo-agentcore.git then `chown -R ssm-user:ssm-user /home/ssm-user/mahalo-agentcore 2>/dev/null || true`; finally `echo 'builder toolchain ready' > /var/log/builder-ready`.

In builder_stack.py create the ec2.Instance passing role=role at CONSTRUCTION (L2 auto-creates the CfnInstanceProfile; do NOT assign instance.role after build), machine_image=ec2.MachineImage.latest_amazon_linux2023(cpu_type=ec2.AmazonLinuxCpuType.ARM_64), instance_type=ec2.InstanceType(builder_instance_type.value_as_string), vpc_subnets PUBLIC, security_group=sg, user_data=user_data, block_devices=[ec2.BlockDevice('/dev/xvda', ec2.BlockDeviceVolume.ebs(builder_volume_size, volume_type=GP3, delete_on_termination=True))]. After construction: instance.instance.associate_public_ip_address = True; instance.apply_removal_policy(RemovalPolicy.DESTROY). Emit CfnOutput BuilderInstanceId and BuilderPublicDns. Do NOT use DockerImageAsset or BundlingOptions anywhere.

MODIFY infra-cdk/app.py: add `from mahalo_infra.builder_stack import MahaloBuilderStack` with the other imports and the single line `MahaloBuilderStack(app, 'MahaloBuilderStack', env=_ENV)` mirroring the other standalone stacks (no cross-references).

MODIFY infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/frontend_stack.py: change the stale module-docstring line (near line 20) that says the `cdk synth --all` template count 'stays 10' to 'is 11'. Grep infra-cdk/ for any other 'stays 10' / '10 templates' doc/comment and update to 11. There is NO executable total-count assertion to edit.

CREATE infra-cdk/tests/test_builder_stack.py mirroring test_gitea_stack.py: a _template() helper building MahaloBuilderStack under env <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>/us-east-1 and returning assertions.Template.from_stack(stack). Tests: one VPC + one Subnet + zero NatGateway; one AWS::EC2::Instance; security group has NO ingress (assert the SG has no SecurityGroupIngress or it is empty); instance is arm64 AL2023 (AMI SSM-parameter default path contains 'al2023' and 'arm64', or assert the ImageId parameter default); a 40 GiB gp3 root BlockDeviceMapping with DeleteOnTermination true; the IAM role references AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore (find_resources AWS::IAM::Role / managed policy arn contains 'AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'); outputs BuilderInstanceId + BuilderPublicDns present; and reuse the `'DockerImage' not in str(template.to_json())` assertion. OPTIONALLY add infra-cdk/tests/test_app.py asserting len(app.synth().stacks) == 11.
Confirm the reused `'DockerImage' not in text` assertion actually holds against the REAL synthesized MahaloBuilderStack template (not assumed) before relying on it.
acceptance_criteria: From infra-cdk/ with its .venv: `cdk synth MahaloBuilderStack` exits 0 with NO Docker and NO AWS credentials (one CloudFormation template produced).
`cdk list` reports exactly 11 stacks including MahaloBuilderStack; `cdk synth --all` exits 0 offline (11 templates, Docker-free).
`pytest tests -q` passes: the prior 42-passed/1-skipped baseline plus the new builder tests, with no regressions.
The synthesized MahaloBuilderStack template contains no 'DockerImage' substring, has zero security-group ingress rules, an arm64 AL2023 instance, and a 40 GiB gp3 delete-on-termination root volume.
No remaining 'stays 10' / '10 templates' stale references in infra-cdk/.
verification: cd infra-cdk && cdk list   (exactly 11 stacks, includes MahaloBuilderStack)
cd infra-cdk && cdk synth --all   (exit 0, 11 templates, no Docker)
cd infra-cdk && pytest tests -q   (all pass incl. test_builder_stack.py; no regression on the 42/1 baseline)
findings:
DONE. Created infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/builder_stack.py (MahaloBuilderStack), wired into app.py (now 11 app stacks), fixed frontend_stack.py docstring 'stays 10'->'is 11', added tests/test_builder_stack.py (8 tests) + tests/test_app.py (11-stack synth assertion). Verification from infra-cdk/ with .venv all green: `cdk synth MahaloBuilderStack` exit 0 offline/Docker-free; `cdk list` = exactly 11 stacks incl. MahaloBuilderStack; `cdk synth --all` exit 0 offline (the only stderr is PowerShell's NativeCommandError wrapper, not a CDK error; exit code 0); `pytest tests -q` = 66 passed, 1 skipped (prior 42/1 baseline + 24 = includes new 8 builder + 1 app tests, no regressions). Confirmed 'DockerImage' substring absent from the real synthesized MahaloBuilderStack template.

DETAILS later steps (FEAT-002 deploy script / FEAT-003 runbook) need:
- CfnOutputs on MahaloBuilderStack: `BuilderInstanceId` (Ref BuilderInstance7F7A60A5 -> use with `aws ssm start-session --target <id>`) and `BuilderPublicDns`.
- Instance logical id: BuilderInstance7F7A60A5. IAM role logical id: BuilderRoleBBEBFA71. The L2 auto-creates exactly ONE AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile (logical id BuilderInstanceProfile...) because role= was passed at construction.
- AMI resolution: an auto-generated SSM-parameter CfnParameter (Type AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>) whose Default is the arm64 AL2023 SSM public-parameter path /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64 (contains both 'al2023' and 'arm64'); resolves at deploy time, no synth-time AWS call.
- CfnParameters: BuilderInstanceType (default t4g.large, arm64 Graviton), BuilderVolumeSizeGiB (default 40). Root volume: /dev/xvda, gp3, DeleteOnTermination=true, size = Ref BuilderVolumeSizeGiB (default 40).
- Security group BuilderSg has ZERO ingress rules (SSM Session Manager only); egress open (allow_all_outbound). Instance role carries AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore + AdministratorAccess (lifetime-scoped, transient single-owner-demo builder).
- UserData (Linux bash, `set -uxo pipefail`, guarded steps) installs: docker (enabled+started), git, Node 24 via NodeSource setup_24.x, python3.13(+pip tolerant), AWS CLI v2, and pins the CDK CLI to `aws-cdk@2.1145.0` (the installed/confirmed CLI version matching aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0 under >=2.251,<3). It clones REPO_URL=https://github.com/tjblavakumar/mahalo-agentcore.git to /home/ssm-user/mahalo-agentcore, chowns to ssm-user, and writes marker `/var/log/builder-ready` ('builder toolchain ready') for the deploy script to poll.
- PINNED CDK CLI VERSION CONFIRMED: 2.1145.0 (build 13877dc); aws-cdk-lib installed 2.273.0.
- Harmless synth warning: CloudFormation-Validate W3010 'Avoid hardcoding availability zones us-east-1a' from the fixed-AZ offline pattern (same as gitea_stack.py); acknowledged by design Â§E.2, not an error.
